description: Analyze any webpage and get structured data about its content: headings, interactive elements (buttons, links, inputs), forms, images, and navigation links. Each element includes its bounding rectangle [x, y, width, height] for visual mapping. Optionally capture a screenshot alongside the analysis. Pro feature with 20 free trial runs per month.

cookies.description: Cookies to set before page load

css.description: Custom CSS to inject before analysis

delay.description: Delay in seconds after page load before analyzing

device.description: Device preset (affects viewport and user agent)

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers as key-value pairs

hide_selectors.description: CSS selectors of elements to hide before analysis

include.description: Which element categories to return. Empty array or omit for all categories

js.description: Custom JavaScript to execute before analysis

scope.description: CSS selector to limit analysis to a specific section (e.g. 'main', '#content')

stealth.description: Enable stealth mode to avoid bot detection

timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the page to load

url.description: URL of the page to analyze (must start with http:// or https://)

visible_only.description: Only return elements visible in the viewport

wait_for_selector.description: Wait for this CSS selector to appear before analyzing

with_screenshot.description: Capture a viewport screenshot alongside the analysis (costs 1 extra API request)

name: analyze_page
